title: 联想CFO温斯顿：芯片管制与AI发展，清晰规则反而利好合规企业
speaker: Winston Chang

segments.en: in terms of the PC business. And Vidya is one of your suppliers. I'm just wondering, has any of the fallout we've seen from Jensen Huang impact that your business is anyway?
segments.zh: 在PC业务方面，Vidya是你们的供应商之一。我想知道，我们从黄仁勋那里看到的任何后果是否会影响你们的业务？

segments.en: We had the likes of Alibaba 10 Cent this week and their earnings.
segments.zh: 本周我们看到了阿里巴巴等公司的财报。

segments.en: Talk about these new chip curves in the US may actually slow down the AI development and affect AI development in China.
segments.zh: 谈论这些美国的新芯片限制可能会减缓AI发展，并影响中国的AI发展。

segments.en: What's your take on all this? Well, I'll break it down into a couple of areas.
segments.zh: 你对此有何看法？我会从几个方面来分析。

segments.en: One is the global demand for compute. And I think that is very much intact.
segments.zh: 一是全球对算力的需求。我认为这基本上没有改变。

segments.en: And Vidya's technology is one of the best in the market. I think that still has a strong demand in the market as with other suppliers.
segments.zh: Vidya的技术是市场上最好的之一。我认为它和其他供应商一样，在市场上仍有强劲需求。

segments.en: So I think there's a market share and other things have not changed in the course of last couple weeks.
segments.zh: 所以我认为市场份额和其他方面在过去几周内没有变化。

segments.en: So that demand continues. In terms of the other complexities that come out, I think clear regulations will actually be better
segments.zh: 所以需求持续存在。就出现的其他复杂情况而言，我认为明确的监管实际上会更好

segments.en: for the market in the long run, because it actually frees up capital and allows people with clear rules to be able to provide compute in a compliant way.
segments.zh: 从长远来看对市场更好，因为它实际上释放了资本，让有明确规则的人能够以合规的方式提供算力。

segments.en: So I think it actually helps companies like us when we are very compliant, but we in fact don't get into other type of transactions.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这实际上对我们这样非常合规的公司有帮助，但我们实际上不参与其他类型的交易。

segments.en: But when there's clear rules, then it complies through the way we operate.
segments.zh: 但规则明确时，我们就能通过运营方式合规。

segments.en: It's even better for us. And I think that actually frees up capital, because a lot of banks are also compliant.
segments.zh: 这对我们更有利。我认为这实际上释放了资本，因为许多银行也合规。

segments.en: So with clarity, I think the capital gets freed up in terms of what they can actually provide to the market.
segments.zh: 因此，清晰度提高后，我认为资本得以释放，他们能向市场提供更多资金。

segments.en: That the market needs today. So not only the market is constrained in terms of components, but also constrained in terms of capital today.
segments.zh: 这是市场今天需要的。所以市场不仅在零部件方面受限，在资本方面也受限。

segments.en: And that capital has a repricing in terms of that cost and they are trying to find the right cost of that capital.
segments.zh: 这些资本的成本正在重估，他们试图找到合适的资本成本。

segments.en: But also in terms of the regulatory aspect.
So with clarity, I think that will also frees up the capital deployment.
segments.zh: 因此，清晰度提高后，我认为这也会释放资本配置。
